summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion centers on how to interpret Parquet files that contain field IDs for only some columns, a situation that current Iceberg readers handle inconsistently. Participants propose a per‑field resolution rule—use an embedded ID when present, otherwise fall back to the name mapping—to bring uniformity and clarify the spec. The session concluded with action items for developers to prepare for the next major update and to ensure a smooth transition to the stable release.
